matrix.name: Stolen mutable lookup-record reference and mock->authentic promotion attempted across ALL CI paths
matrix.assertion: Record returned by lookupVerifiedRemoteCiRun is frozen; mutating property fails or does not affect registry

matrix.name: Direct signer export / testKey / old Symbol.for token / helper injection rejected
matrix.assertion: TRUSTED_ORCHESTRATOR_CAPABILITY and _privateMintCiAttestationToken are undefined; mintCiAttestationToken has no testKey parameter

matrix.name: Forged valid-hex responseDigest + correct HMAC but no official run => CI_NOT_RUN
matrix.assertion: HMAC token signed by test fixture signer fails verification in evaluateReleaseEvidence due to unregistered run

matrix.name: Authenticated-looking customFetch and unit/mock origin remains quarantined
matrix.assertion: verifyRemoteGitHubActionsRun with customFetch forces isUnitTestMock: true and evaluator rejects with RELEASE_EVALUATOR_REJECTED_MOCK_CI

matrix.name: Exact workflow allowlist, exact run ID/SHA/repo/branch/event, TTL/replay/conflict negative controls
matrix.assertion: Partial / prefix workflow names rejected with WORKFLOW_NOT_ALLOWED; exact allowed name succeeds

matrix.name: Authentic-verified run registration failure cannot return signed CI_PASS
matrix.assertion: Registration conflict or failure triggers fail-closed CI_FAIL status with no token issued

matrix.name: Vitest exit=0 but missing/empty/fake/mismatched summary => ENGINEERING_FAIL
matrix.assertion: Missing summary, zero test count, or arithmetic count mismatch returns ENGINEERING_FAIL even if exit code is 0

matrix.name: E8 JSON malformed/stale/empty; policy PASS with insufficient history is not business PASS
matrix.assertion: Malformed output rejected; backtest with 0 covered days correctly recognized as business insufficient evidence

matrix.name: E9 malformed/incorrect schema, no DB readback, 6 raw rows but zero eligible => G15/G16 insufficient
matrix.assertion: Readback script parses candidate DB record, validates 6 raw rows with 0 eligible, upholding G15/G16 fail-closed

matrix.name: E10 CI_NOT_CONFIGURED/NOT_RUN and fake providerVerified true => CI PASS rejected
matrix.assertion: Gate validator rejects diagnostic claiming providerVerified=true with CI_NOT_CONFIGURED as ENGINEERING_FAIL

matrix.name: statfs failure, ENOSPC, low RAM, disk pressure while running => fail closed
matrix.assertion: Simulated low disk (<1GB), low RAM (<150MB), or statfs failure throws SAFE_CHECK_FAILED

matrix.name: logs > cap flags TRUNCATED_FAIL
matrix.assertion: Logs exceeding 50 MB threshold return status TRUNCATED_FAIL

matrix.name: Tracked/untracked source mutation during run, HEAD/tree mismatch => detected
matrix.assertion: HEAD or tree drift triggers HEAD_MUTATED or TREE_MUTATED fail-closed error

matrix.name: TailRingBuffer retains recent log tail lines deterministically
matrix.assertion: Ring buffer accurately maintains FIFO tail lines across stdout/stderr stream chunks

matrix.name: MCP import-only => providerVerified=false; handshake/tools/list => protocol status only
matrix.assertion: FastMCP stdio handshake discovers tools search_advertiser, get_advertiser_ads at $0.00 with providerVerified=false

matrix.name: Missing Meta/HasData keys, TikTok Ads US deferred, BigQuery no billing => no spend
matrix.assertion: All non-configured sources report zero cost ($0.00); TikTok Ads US remains DEFERRED_DO_NOT_TEST

matrix.name: DEV/HOLDOUT chronological cutoff no-lookahead
matrix.assertion: Backtest replay provenance confirms pointInTimeCutoff strictly enforced with zero future leakage

matrix.name: Stale/fake/renamed/nonofficial Google Trends CSV with checksum only never grants authenticated origin
matrix.assertion: Checksum integrity alone without verified external Google issuance demotes observation to CACHED_UNVERIFIED
